title: NEXUS terminal performance v2
description: Terminal-only NEXUS evaluation statistics. These fields describe the realized run relative to mechanically qualified physical and guaranteed-policy baselines. Diagnostic fields are emitted only after the session reaches won or failed and are never exposed while play is active. Signed deltas may be negative; a negative value means the realized hidden-world run used fewer actions than the comparison baseline and must not be interpreted by itself as superior reasoning.

$schema.description: Immutable raw GitHub URL of the JSON Schema version used to interpret this performance object.

planning_level.description: Generated planning profile P0-P3. P3 adds a mechanically qualified delivery dependency without increasing the P2 room-count range.

resource_pressure.description: Action-budget pressure R0-R2. R0 is forgiving, R1 constrained, and R2 gives exactly the guaranteed-policy action budget.

terminal_status.description: Terminal outcome when these statistics were emitted.

initial_action_budget.description: Environment actions available at episode start. Accepted consuming actions decrement this budget; invalid requests and non-consuming observe operations do not.

resource_allowance.description: Actions added above guaranteed_policy_actions by the selected resource-pressure profile. At R2 this is zero.

planning_dependency_action_cost.description: Mechanically recomputed physical and guaranteed-policy overhead caused by the P3 delivery dependency. Zero for P0-P2.

actions_used.description: Accepted consuming environment actions executed by the session. Invalid actions, duplicate transport retries, protocol conflicts, and non-consuming observe calls are excluded.

optimal_physical_actions.description: Shortest action count for an omniscient agent in the selected hidden world, proved independently by concrete-state BFS. Probe actions are unnecessary for this omniscient baseline.

minimum_guaranteed_probes.description: Minimum worst-case number of probe actions required by the causal-discovery guarantee for the profile.

guaranteed_policy_actions.description: Exact minimum worst-case total environment-action cost of a policy guaranteed to win across all public-evidence-consistent viable hidden worlds.

action_delta_from_guaranteed_policy.description: actions_used minus guaranteed_policy_actions. Positive means extra realized actions; zero matches the minimax guarantee; negative can result from a favorable realized hidden world or epistemic risk.

action_delta_from_physical_optimum.description: actions_used minus the omniscient selected-world physical optimum. On failed episodes this may be negative because the run terminated before completing the mission.

probes_used.description: Probe actions actually executed in this run.

probe_delta_from_guaranteed_minimum.description: probes_used minus minimum_guaranteed_probes. Negative values are possible when the agent commits without all information needed for a guaranteed policy.

movement_actions.description: Accepted move actions executed in the run.

wait_actions.description: Accepted wait actions executed in the run.

operate_actions.description: Accepted destructive machine operate actions executed in the run.

take_actions.description: Accepted take actions executed in the run.

drop_actions.description: Accepted drop actions executed in the run.

finish_actions.description: Accepted finish actions executed in the run, including rejected finishes that consumed an action.

unique_rooms_visited.description: Number of distinct rooms occupied by the agent during the run, including the starting room.

room_revisits.description: Move actions whose destination had already been visited earlier in the run. This is descriptive navigation telemetry, not by itself proof of waste.

goal_satisfied_at_terminal.description: Whether the declarative goal predicate is true in the terminal world state. A failed finish or budget exhaustion can leave this false.

unsatisfied_goal_conditions.description: Terminal-only concise descriptions of unsatisfied conjunctive goal conditions. Complex non-conjunctive failures are represented as a compact predicate description. Empty when the goal is satisfied.

budget_remaining.description: Unused environment actions at terminal state.

invalid_actions.description: Rejected game actions that did not consume an environment action or mutate state.

failed_finishes.description: Accepted finish actions that consumed an environment action while the victory predicate was false.

duplicate_requests.description: Idempotent retries of an already committed turn with the same action. These do not count toward actions_used.

protocol_conflicts.description: Rejected stale/mismatched turn requests or retries that supplied a different action for an already committed turn. These do not count toward actions_used.
